entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I assist you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I think I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into a return for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your name and order number?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... VF8-99120.

Thank you, Sarah. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 20th. Now, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it's not broken. I just opened it and it seems very complicated. I don't think I'll be able to use it, so I wanted to send it back.

I understand. Looking at the delivery date, it appears we're on day 13. I do need to let you know that the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return policy. After that period, we're generally unable to process a return.
Ten days? Oh, no. I had no idea. I... I'm so sorry, there was a family emergency. We've been completely overwhelmed. Can't you just help me? This is all too much right now.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Of course, we have exceptions for serious life events. Could you tell me a little more about what happened?
My husband was rushed to the hospital. He needed emergency surgery and we've been there for the last week and a half. I honestly completely forgot this package had even arrived until today.

Oh my, I am so sorry to hear that. I truly hope he's on the road to a full recovery. Thank you for sharing that with me. That situation absolutely qualifies for an exception. Please allow me to place you on a brief hold while I authorize this for you.
Thank you for your patience, Sarah. I've gone ahead and approved a full refund as a one-time exception due to the circumstances. I've just processed the return authorization.
You did? Oh, thank you. Thank you so much. That's a huge weight off my mind. I really appreciate your understanding.

It's the least we can do at VeloFit. You should receive an email with a pre-paid return label in the next few minutes. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful, Diana. Thank you again.
You're very welcome, Sarah. We wish your husband a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a good day.
